_comment: Run template for the lbnl-sdahu catalog entry. `camber datasets config lbnl-sdahu --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. Hourly resample; every scenario is an equipment AHU__<scenario>, so one run scores them all. The design minimum OA is this unit's own: a fixed 10% damper position (inventory section 1.2) that measures as a 1.6% OA fraction (median of 119,163 occupied, fan-on minutes of the fault-free run) -- not a generic 20%. outdoor_air_fraction judges fan-on samples in the simulation's own occupied mode (SYS_CTL). The economizer runs between 33.8 F and 60 F with a fixed dry-bulb high limit (section 1.2), hence high_limit_f 60 without the differential changeover; the 33.8 F low-limit lockout is by design.
